newsitem.title: USA: USA Detergents Inc named in class action.
newsitem.headline: USA Detergents Inc named in class action.

text.p: USA Detergents Inc was named in a class-action lawsuit filed in U.S. federal court alleging it made false statements about its distribution network, plaintiffs' lawyers said on Wednesday.

The lawsuit, brought in the U.S. District Court of New Jersey, alleges the company and some of its officers omitted information about known problems with the distribution network and the impact of those problems on the company's financial results.
The suit was brought on behalf of investors who bought common stock in USA Detergents between September 13, 1996, and April 24, 1997, lawyers said in a statement.

The company, which makes laundry and household cleaning products, was also named in a May 19 filing on behalf of investors who said the company misrepresented the true condition of its business, inflating stock prices.
No one was immediately available to comment on the case on behalf of USA Detergents, and plaintiffs' lawyers did not disclose whether they were seeking damages in the case.
